operation.summary: Granular SFTP operations; files_read or files_write permission; can be scheduled

body.name: connection
body.description: This agent's saved SSH connection id

body.name: path
body.description: Literal remote path; relative to SFTP home or absolute. Wildcards are escaped.

body.name: timeout_seconds
body.description: Total connect + operation deadline, 1..120 seconds; default 30. Disconnect does not guarantee remote termination.

body.name: offset
body.description: Read byte offset, or list entry offset; write requires 0; 0..1000000000000, default 0

body.name: limit
body.description: List entry count 1..1000; default 200. Pagination is not a snapshot.

body.name: data_base64
body.description: write: base64 bytes, at most 512 KiB decoded

body.name: write_mode
body.description: write: replace (default, truncates) or append. Upload larger files in sequential chunks: replace first, append subsequent chunks. Do not use concurrent writers.

body.name: destination
body.description: rename: literal destination path; may replace existing destination

body.name: confirm
body.description: Must be true for write, rename, remove, rmdir and chmod. Writes may replace data; failed writes may be partial.

operation.returns: action,path; stat attributes; list entries,next_offset; read data_base64,bytes,offset,eof,next_offset; write bytes_written,write_mode,size. Remote filesystem ACLs apply; directory deletion is nonrecursive.
